concept_gloss.applicability: Nedene bağlı ortaya çıkma çekirdeğiyle sonradan oluşturulmuş, uydurulmuş ve katışıksız olmayan uzantıları birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Kaynak ile sonuç arasındaki neden bağını ve sonradan üretilmiş olma yönünü korur.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyden nedenle türeme veya sonradan oluşturulma

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz biriminde bir şeyin başka bir şeyden bir neden aracılığıyla ortaya çıkması. Buna bağlı olarak sonradan oluşturulan söz, uydurulan kitap veya kanıt ve katışıksız sayılmayan dil ya da kişi de kendi biçim ve kalıplarında nitelenir.

facets.statement: Belirli söz biriminde bir şey, başka bir şeyden bir neden aracılığıyla ortaya çıkar.
Sonradan oluşturulan söz bu ortaya çıkma düşüncesinin bir uzantısıdır.
Uydurulmuş kitap ve doğrulanmamış, üretilmiş kanıt aynı niteleme alanındadır.
Katışıksız sayılmayan dil veya kişi için de bu niteleme kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sonucun başka bir şeyden belirli bir nedenle çıktığı süreçlerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kaynak, neden ve ortaya çıkan sonuç arasındaki bağı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Daha önce bulunmayıp sonradan üretilen bir söz veya benzeri oluşum için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sonradan ortaya çıkarılmış olma özelliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gerçekliği bulunmayan veya doğrulanmamış kitap ve kanıt gibi örneklerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçek olmayıp sonradan üretilmiş olma yönünü korur.

error_profile.loses: Ortaya çıkışın neden bağını, sürecini ve sonradan oluşturulmuş ya da uydurulmuş nitelemelerini kaybeder.
error_profile.preserves: Başka bir şeyden ortaya çıkan son ürünü gösterir.

error_profile.adds: Başka bir kaynaktan türemeyen ve örneksiz başlayan oluşturma türlerini de kapsama ekler.
error_profile.collision: Bir kaynaktan nedenle türeme ile kaynaksız başlatmayı karıştırabilir.
error_profile.preserves: Daha önce bulunmayan bir şeyin ortaya çıkması yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek doğurma olayını değil nedene bağlı ortaya çıkmayı, sonradan oluşturulmayı, uydurulmayı ve katışıksız sayılmamayı anlatır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin başka bir şeyden bir nedenle ortaya çıkmasını çekirdek yapar; sonradan oluşturulmuş söz, uydurulmuş kitap veya kanıt ve katışıksız sayılmayan dil ya da kişi kullanımlarını buna bağlar. Verilen dal bu çekirdek ile uzantıları doğru biçimde toplar.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyin başka bir şeyden bir nedenle ortaya çıkması
sonradan oluşturulmuş, uydurulmuş veya katışıksız olmayan

lexicalization_scope.note: Nedene bağlı ortaya çıkma yalnız ilgili söz biriminde çekirdektir; sonradan oluşturulmuş, uydurulmuş ve katışıksız olmayan anlamlar kendi biçim ve kalıplarıyla ayrı tutulur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen dört komşu uydurma, örneksiz başlatma, yararlı sonuç ve genel var etme karşısındaki sınırları açıklar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeği başka bir şeyden nedenle ortaya çıkmadır ve uydurma yalnız bir uzantıdır; komşu dal gerçeğe aykırı ürün kurmayı doğrudan merkezine alır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal uydurma yanında nedene bağlı ortaya çıkmayı, sonradan oluşturulmayı ve katışıksız olmamayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: türeme veya sonradan üretme / düzmece kurma
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalan, düzmece anlatı, şiir ve ezgi gibi gerçeğe aykırı biçimde kurulmuş ürünlere yoğunlaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Uydurulmuş bir söz ya da metin iki dalın kesiştiği alandır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda ortaya çıkan şeyin bir kaynağı ve nedeni vardır; komşu dalda yenilik, önceki bir örnek bulunmamasına dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal başka bir şeyden neden yoluyla çıkmayı ve türetilmiş olmayı temel alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal önceden örneği bulunmayan bir şeyi ilk kez başlatmayı veya yapmayı temel alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yeni bir şeyin ortaya çıkması alanında buluşur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çıkış ilişkisini ve sonradan üretilmişliği anlatır; komşu dal çıkan şeyin yararlı bir ürün veya kazanç olmasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bir şeyin başka bir şeyden çıkma sürecini ve sonradan oluşturulmuş ürünleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ortaya çıkan yararlı sonucu ve bir şeyin verdiği ürünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kaynaktan çıkan sonuç düşüncesi iki dalı birbirine yaklaştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kaynak ile sonuç arasındaki türeme bağını gerektirir; komşu dal bu bağı şart koşmadan genel var etme ve başlatmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal başka bir kaynaktan neden aracılığıyla türemeyi şart koşar ve uydurma uzantıları taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi var etmeyi, başlatmayı, bulmayı ve yapıtını ortaya koymayı genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yeni bir varlık veya ürünün ortaya çıkması iki dalın ortak alanıdır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: تولد الشيء عن الشيء حصل عنه (maqayis)؛ عربية مولدة ورجل مولد إذا كان عربيا غير محض (sihah)؛ المولد من الكلام مولدا إذا استحدثوه؛ كتاب مولد أي مفتعل؛ بينة مولدة وليست بمحققة (tahdhib)؛ تولد الشيء من الشيء حصوله عنه بسبب من الأسباب (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların toplu anlatımı nedene bağlı türemeyi merkeze alır; sonradan oluşturulmuş söz, uydurulmuş metin veya kanıt ve katışıksız sayılmayan dil ya da kişi bu çekirdeğin yerleşmiş uzantılarıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تولد الشيء من الشيء إذا حصل عنه بسبب، والمولد من الكلام إذا استحدث، وما كان غير محض أو ناشئا في بيئة معينة مثل عربية مولدة ورجل مولد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل هنا النسل الآدمي المباشر إلا من جهة القياس العام، ولا الولادة الحسية نفسها.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişiyle aynı yaşta olan kimseyi, başka benzerlik veya arkadaşlık şartı eklemeden karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İki kişi arasındaki yaş eşitliğini doğrudan ve eksiksiz korur.

concept_map.definition: Başka bir kişiyle aynı yaşta olan kimse; yaş bakımından onun dengi.

facets.statement: İki kişi arasındaki belirleyici bağ aynı yaşta olmalarıdır.
Adın tekil, ikili ve çoğul biçimleri bir veya birden çok yaştaşı gösterebilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yaştaşlık ilişkisinin bir cümle içinde açıkça çözülmesi gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılaştırılan iki kişinin yaş eşitliğini açıkça korur.

error_profile.adds: Yaş eşitliği gerektirmeyen kişisel yakınlık ve birlikte bulunma ilişkisini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Yaştaşlık ile kişisel dostluğu birbirine karıştırır.
error_profile.loses: Aynı yaşta olma şartını bütünüyle kaybeder.
error_profile.preserves: İki kişi arasında yakın bir bağ bulunduğu çağrışımını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel benzerlik veya arkadaşlık değil, özellikle aynı yaşta olma bakımından denk kişiyi gösterir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişiyi başka bir kişinin yaştaşı ve dengi olarak tanımlar; biçimin kökenine ve çoğul kullanımına ilişkin bilgiler de bu çekirdeği değiştirmez. Verilen dal çerçevesi yaş eşitliğini doğru biçimde merkeze alır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yaştaş anlamıyla sınırlıdır; güç, tür, arkadaşlık veya genel benzerlik gibi ek ölçütler içeri alınmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; yayımlanan üç komşu yaş eşitliğine arkadaşlık, güç denkliği veya genel benzerlik ekleyen sınırları gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yaş eşitliğini tek belirleyici sınır yapar; komşu dal aynı yaş çevresine arkadaşlık veya birlikte yetişme bağını da katabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal için aynı yaşta olmak yeterlidir; birlikte büyüme veya arkadaşlık şart değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yaş eşitliğinin yanında arkadaşlığı, yakınlığı ve birlikte büyümeyi de çağrıştırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı yaşta olan iki kişi iki dalın ortak çekirdeğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal aynı yaş koşulundan ayrılmaz; komşu dal denkliği güç ve yiğitlik gibi başka karşılaştırma ölçülerine genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal denkliği yalnız yaş ölçüsüne göre kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yaş yanında yiğitlik, güç ve dayanıklılık bakımından denk rakibi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yaş bakımından denk kişi iki dalın kesiştiği alandır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal denklik ölçüsünü yaş olarak sabitler; komşu dal benzerlik ve denkliği belirli bir ölçüyle sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal benzerliği yalnız iki kişinin aynı yaşta olmasına bağlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yaş şartı olmadan tür, durum veya başka özelliklerde benzer ve denk olanı gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişinin başka bir kişiye denk sayılması iki dalı yakınlaştırır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: اللدة نقصانه الواو لأن أصله ولدة (maqayis)؛ لدة الرجل تربه؛ وهما لدان والجمع لدات ولدون (sihah)؛ اللدة مختصة بالترب يقال فلان لدة فلان وتربه (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği aynı yaşta olan denk kişidir; tekil, ikili ve çoğul biçim bilgileri bu yaştaşlık ilişkisini sayı bakımından çeşitlendirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اللدة أو لدة الرجل بمعنى تربه ومثيله في السن.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل هنا الولد بمعنى الابن ولا الوالد ولا التولد.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kanıtta verilen sabit söyleyişin anlamını karşılar; yalın bir sözcük anlamı olarak kullanılamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Durumun büyüklük ve ağırlık yönüyle şeyin bolluk yönünü birlikte korur.

concept_gloss.text: çok büyük bir durum ya da pek bol bir şey

concept_map.definition: Yalnız belirli bir kalıp söz içinde, çok büyük veya ağır bir durumu ya da çok bol bir şeyi anlatır. Söyleyişin kökeni baskına bağlanır; çok yiyecek ve çok otlak bolluk örnekleridir.

facets.statement: Kalıp söz çok büyük, önemli veya ağır bir durumu anlatır.
Aynı kalıp söz çok bol bir şeyi anlatmak için de kullanılır.
Söyleyişin çıkışı, baskın sırasında yaşanan ağır duruma bağlanır.
Çok yiyecek ve çok otlak, bolluk yönünün açık örnekleridir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kalıp söz büyük, önemli ve ağır bir olay veya durum için söylendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Durumun olağanüstü büyüklük ve ağırlık derecesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kalıp söz yiyecek veya otlak gibi bir şeyin çokluğunu anlatırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin olağanüstü bolluk derecesini ilgili bağlamda korur.

error_profile.adds: Gerçek bir çocuğun çağrılmadığı sıradan bir olayı anlamın içine ekler.
error_profile.collision: Sabit söyleyişin yerleşmiş anlamını sözcüğü sözcüğüne bir olayla karıştırır.
error_profile.loses: Çok büyük veya ağır durum ile çok bol şey bildiren yerleşmiş anlamı kaybeder.
error_profile.preserves: Kalıbın sözcük düzeyindeki çağırma ve çocuk görüntüsünü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız verilen kalıp sözde geçerlidir; tek başına çocuk adını veya bu kalıp dışında kalan her büyüklük ve bolluk durumunu kapsamaz.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız sabit bir söyleyiş içinde çok büyük veya ağır bir durumu ve çok bol bir şeyi anlatır; kökeni baskına bağlar, yiyecek ve otlağı bolluk örnekleri olarak verir. Ön çerçevedeki süt örneği yetkili kaynak ifadesinde bulunmadığından tanım bu örneği dışarıda bırakacak biçimde yeniden kurulmalıdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: çok büyük veya ağır bir durum yahut çok bol bir şey için söylenen kalıp söz

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız verilen sabit söyleyişe bağlıdır; buradaki büyüklük, ağırlık ve bolluk anlamları yalın kök anlamına genellenmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Verilen bütün komşu adayları değerlendirildi; hiçbiri bu sabit söyleyişin büyük olay ve bolluk sınırını doğrudan paylaşmadığından yayımlanacak yararlı bir karşılaştırma bulunmadı.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أمر لا ينادى وليده؛ قيل ذلك لكل أمر عظيم ولكل شيء كثير (sihah)؛ هو أمر لا ينادى وليده؛ أمر جليل شديد؛ أصله في الغارة؛ طعام لا ينادى وليده؛ عشب لا ينادى وليده (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, sabit söyleyişi büyük veya ağır durum ile bolluk arasında açıklar; çıkışını baskına bağlar ve yiyecek ile otlağı bolluk örnekleri olarak verir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المثل لا ينادى وليده وما فسرته المصادر من أمر عظيم أو شديد، أو شيء كثير، أو غارة تذهل الأم عن ولدها، أو طعام ولبن وعشب كثير لا يحتاج فيه إلى نداء الوليد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل هنا معنى الوليد المفرد خارج هذا التركيب، ولا كل شدة أو كثرة بلا هذا المثل.

root_profile.summary: Kökün ana alanı doğum çevresinde çocuk, öz ana baba, doğurma olayı ve yeni doğmuş çocuk adlandırmalarını kurar. Bundan nedene bağlı türeme, sonradan oluşturulma, aynı yaşta olma ve büyüklük ya da bolluk bildiren sabit bir söyleyiş gibi yerleşmiş yan dallar gelişir.

text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّۢ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا

baseline.text: Rabbin yalnız kendisine kulluk etmenizi ve anne babaya iyi davranmanızı buyurdu. Onlardan biri ya da ikisi senin yanında yaşlılığa ulaşırsa onlara 'öf' bile deme, onları azarlama ve onlara saygılı bir söz söyle.

findings.text: Yalnız Allah'a kulluk buyruğu, yaşlanan anne babanın değerini incitmeyen küçük söz seçimlerinde sınanarak dikey bağlılığı yatay bir korumaya dönüştürür.
Yaşlılık, çocuğu bir zamanlar kendi büyümesini taşıyanların yakın koruyucusu konumuna getirerek bakımın yönünü tersine çevirir.

activation_trace.role: The cutting judgment branch makes the opening a settled and binding frame for both clauses.
Lordship and mastery supply the authority under which worship and parental conduct are joined.
Humble obedient worship defines the exclusive vertical allegiance that immediately governs the human relation.
The two parents specifically identified through birth make embodied origin, not generic seniority, the relation at issue.
Beneficent and well-executed action, including surplus beyond strict justice, turns the clause into an affirmative practice.

changed_reading.after: The family command belongs to the same decisive settlement as exclusive worship, so theology is immediately tested as active excellence toward one's parents.
changed_reading.before: The ayah gives a religious command followed by a family command.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قضى ربك ألا تعبدوا إلا إياه وبالوالدين إحسانا
baseline_models.mechanism: A decisive lordly settlement joins exclusive worship to active beneficence toward both parents. The second clause is not an optional courtesy appended to theology; it is placed inside the same binding order, and ihsan demands positive good rather than bare non-injury.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at a temporal endpoint makes aging a reached condition that triggers the detailed speech duties.
Nearness and presence locate parental vulnerability inside the addressee's immediate field of responsibility.
Senescence and long duration identify the life-stage whose arrival changes the relation.
The branch of burdensome weight exposes why this stage can strain the caregiver and why restraint is specified.
Singularity keeps the duty fully active even when only one parent reaches the condition.
Dual encompassment closes the other case by including both parents without dilution of responsibility.

changed_reading.after: Old age arriving within one's own household or reach creates a non-evadable proximity duty, whether dependency appears in one parent or both.
changed_reading.before: The ayah gives an age-contingent rule for speaking politely.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إما يبلغن عندك الكبر أحدهما أو كلاهما
baseline_models.mechanism: The duty intensifies when old age reaches its endpoint within the addressee's own sphere. Nearness removes abstraction, the weight of age increases vulnerability, and the one-or-both construction prevents either scale of need from escaping the command.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance appears in prohibition, command, and object form, making voiced speech the controlled medium.
The smallest voiced discharge of weariness marks the earliest detectable point in the escalation.
Harsh verbal driving-away supplies the stronger aggressive endpoint that must also be blocked.
Honor, generosity, and pardon qualify the replacement speech as dignity-giving rather than merely neutral.

changed_reading.after: Interrupt the whole verbal escalation from reflexive sigh to forceful rebuke, then actively replace it with speech that restores and displays their honor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فلا تقل لهما أف ولا تنهرهما وقل لهما قولا كريما
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence intercepts an escalation: a minimal sound of disgust, then forceful verbal expulsion, then an explicit replacement utterance. Silence is insufficient; the mouth must be retrained from reactive discharge into speech that actively confers honor.

activation_trace.role: Birth-origin identifies the pair whose earlier generative role is about to be reversed.
Old age supplies the later-life endpoint at which the direction of practical care changes.
Lowering after height turns the adult child's present strength into a deliberate downward movement toward the parents.
Wing as side, hand, and shelter gives the lowering an embodied protective shape.
Gentleness of side without abasement distinguishes chosen tenderness from degrading submission.
Tender mercy supplies both the motive for bodily lowering and the substance requested in prayer.
Feeding and gradual growth name the parents' earlier work that the adult child's care now answers.
Smallness opposite old age completes the life-course reversal between dependency at the two ends.

changed_reading.after: The adult child reenacts care in reverse across the life course: remembered nurture is translated into gentle embodied protection when the former caregivers become vulnerable.
changed_reading.before: The aged parent receives deference because of status and kinship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah turns the focus into a developmental reversal. Those who raised the addressee through smallness now reach old age nearby; the presently stronger body lowers its side without humiliation, encloses them in mercy, and converts remembered nurture into present care and prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies old age, smallness, nurture, lowered embodiment, and mercy; I supply the arrow from remembered upward nurture to transformed downward care. A live alternative is simple gratitude rather than a full role-reversal mechanism.
structural_cues: The old-age condition in 17:23 is immediately answered by the memory of being raised while small in 17:24.
The imperatives move from governing the mouth to lowering the body and then to prayer.

activation_trace.role: The involuntary-seeming sound of weariness exposes the boundary between inner pressure and voiced harm.
Overt speech remains the observable practice that must be changed rather than excused.
Disclosure to the knower moves evaluation behind the polished utterance into the agent's actual orientation.
The inward seat of thought and alarm supplies the hidden field known beneath speech.
Soundness opposed to corruption makes the relevant inner direction constructive rather than merely emotional.
Returning to a place of return makes correction repeatable after departure from the commanded manner.
Covering a fault and protecting its bearer from its residue keeps repair from becoming denial of the wrong.

changed_reading.after: The threshold belongs to an inward and repeatable repair practice: intention is exposed, return remains possible, and forgiveness supports correction without weakening the ban on harmful speech.
changed_reading.before: The command is chiefly an external threshold governing which words may be uttered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The absolute speech boundary is followed by inward knowledge, sound orientation, repeated return, and covering forgiveness. This preserves the prohibition while placing filial conduct inside a repairable discipline: inner resentment matters, outward polish alone is insufficient, and a lapse need not become permanent estrangement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward knowledge, soundness, return, and forgiveness; I supply the arrow from those cues to repair after failures in filial speech. The live alternative is that 17:25 offers general reassurance without specifically modeling such lapses.
structural_cues: 17:25 immediately follows the detailed parental speech commands.
The conditional sound orientation is paired with a plural description of habitual returners.

activation_trace.role: Active beneficence supplies the focus practice whose material scope and limits are clarified by the sequence.
A binding entitlement changes kin-directed goodness from discretionary generosity into something owed.
Voiced speech remains an available act when the giver must turn away from a material request.
Ease after difficulty makes speech a low-friction form of care that keeps scarcity from becoming relational harshness.
The binding collar supplies the image of disabling restraint at one failed extreme of giving.
An entirely released hand supplies the opposite extreme of unbounded expenditure.
Restriction to a small measure introduces real capacity limits into the practice of provision.
The balance of justice supplies a governing metric between withholding and self-defeating excess.

changed_reading.after: Ihsan is an owed but calibrated practice: give within real capacity, never convert inability into contempt, and let dignifying speech continue care when material provision cannot.
changed_reading.before: Ihsan to parents means open-ended generosity and kind words.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding commands turn ihsan into a calibrated care economy. A relative's claim is a due right; when material giving is unavailable, accessible speech still preserves relation; generosity must avoid both a shackled hand and total extension; and capacity is measured rather than imagined as limitless.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies right, substitute speech, opposed hand positions, restricted provision, and balance; I supply the arrow back to parental ihsan as a sustainable allocation practice. A live alternative is that these are adjacent duties to other recipients rather than specifications of parental care.
structural_cues: The sequence moves from giving a relative's right, through graceful speech under inability, to the two extremes of the hand and finally to just measure.

activation_trace.role: Parents viewed from the event of birth establish the older generation as one pole of the relation.

changed_reading.after: It becomes one pole of a bidirectional intergenerational protection: neither generation may answer the other generation's dependency by erasure, contempt, or abandonment.
changed_reading.before: The focus imposes a one-way upward duty from adult child to aging parent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The birth-root changes roles from parents in the focus to children in 17:31. context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root reversal, age-burden, poverty fear, killing, and provision; I supply the common anti-disposability rule across the two generations. A live alternative is to keep infanticide wholly separate from care of aged parents.
structural_cues: The same birth-root names parents in 17:23 and children in 17:31.
Both passages address pressure created by a dependent family member, but from opposite generational directions.

activation_trace.role: Reaching the endpoint introduces old age as one threshold at which another person's duty becomes active.
Senescence defines the late-life threshold and its altered practical dependency.
A child cut off from a caretaker supplies the contrasting vulnerable person placed under another's power.
The same reaching-to-an-endpoint branch links the two passages while the destination changes from old age to maturity.
Arrival at mature strength supplies the early-life threshold opposite parental senescence.
Completion without deficit makes stewardship answerable for returning every due intact.
Preserving something through repeated attention supplies the temporal discipline of trustworthy custody.

changed_reading.after: The child holds a stewardship at a late-life threshold, parallel to guardianship at the threshold before maturity: vulnerability grants responsibility, not ownership or unchecked control.
changed_reading.before: The child owes kindness once a parent becomes old.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated reaching verb marks opposite thresholds. In the focus, a parent reaches old age inside the child's care; in 17:34, an orphan reaches mature strength inside a guardian's custody. Fulfilment and a repeatedly maintained covenant recast power over a vulnerable person's affairs as temporary stewardship rather than ownership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reaching, opposite age thresholds, orphan custody, completion, and maintained covenant; I supply the analogy that parental care is likewise custodial rather than possessive. A live alternative is that the repetition only coordinates distinct legal thresholds.
structural_cues: The exact root ب ل غ governs both reaching old age in 17:23 and reaching mature strength in 17:34.
The two complements point to opposite ends of a life course while each passage regulates power around vulnerability.

activation_trace.role: Overt utterance is the point where an untested judgment can become relational harm.
Harsh rebuke is the speech act whose apparent certainty and force require restraint.
Following an apparent trace supplies the mechanism by which incomplete evidence can harden into a claim.

Insight of the heart distinguishes surface observation from the deeper seeing needed before judgment.

changed_reading.after: Noble speech also requires epistemic discipline: listen, test what is known, and do not convert frustration or partial perception into a forceful verdict on aging parents.
changed_reading.before: Noble speech is primarily a matter of respectful wording and tone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later ban on following what one does not know, followed by the accountability of hearing, sight, and heart, adds an epistemic brake to the focus speech sequence. Noble speech toward aging parents is not only gentle in tone; it refuses to turn partial perception, repeated frustration, or fault-tracking into confident accusation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech control, non-pursuit without knowledge, accountable senses, and the heated heart; I supply the arrow from epistemic restraint to family speech under frustration. A live alternative is a general rule for testimony and belief with no special return to parents.
structural_cues: A command about utterance in 17:23 is later paired with a prohibition on pursuing the unknown.

activation_trace.role: Decisive judgment opens the unit as an authoritative settlement rather than private advice.

context_deltas.mechanism: A deictic and theological frame closes around the focus. The parents reach old age 'at you,' while the sequence's evils are judged 'at your Lord.' context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the deictic echo and theological bookend; I supply the arrow that makes the household a delegated jurisdiction under divine review. remaining_uncertainties: The calibrated-care model may be a deliberate return to parental ihsan, or the sequence may chiefly coordinate distinct duties to distinct recipients.

strongest_changes: 17:24 changes deference into a life-course reversal in which remembered nurture becomes gentle embodied care.
17:26-35 changes ihsan from unbounded sentiment into an owed, sustainable, and measured care economy.

summary.what_was_special: The most productive activations were structural rather than topical: opposite life thresholds linked by ب ل غ, generational role reversal through و ل د, speech retained as care when material giving fails, and the deictic transfer from the child's near-space to the Lord's evaluative presence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Exclusive worship is tested as speech restraint at another's decline.** `ق ض ي:B001` gives decisive command, `ع ب د:B003` submissive obedience, `ء ف ف:B001` disgust, `ن ه ر:B004` harsh rebuke, and `ك ر م:B001/B010` generous nobility and valuedness. The command descends from divine exclusivity into the micro-choices of speech toward aged parents. I infer worship's vertical claim must produce horizontal preservation of vulnerable worth. “Noble speech” becomes enacted servanthood.
2. **Old age reverses the direction of nurture.** `و ل د:B002/B003` encodes birth relation, `ب ل غ:B001` reaching a limit, and `ك ب ر:B004` agedness. Later 17:24 explicitly recalls being raised small. I infer the child now becomes the proximal holder of those who once carried growth. The ayah reads aging as a relational handover rather than private decline.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:62–65 contrasts Satan's attempt to bridle descendants with the protected solidity of servants. Gentle care for dependent parents becomes a local counter-practice to domination.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Noble speech as support at the threshold of dependence.** Lexical evidence: `ن ه ر B004` (harsh verbal rebuke) in negated `تَنْهَرْهُمَا`, and `ك ر م B001` (praiseworthy nobility and generosity) in `كَرِيمًا`. Structural cue: the parents reach old age `عِندَكَ`; 17:22 warns against being left unsupported, 17:24 supplies the sheltering wing, and 17:26 extends due claims to kin. Assigned role: rebuke would push the dependent away, whereas noble speech receives and sustains them socially. Abductive move: the packet supplies proximity, age, and contrasting speech commands; I infer that verbal hospitality is part of material care. Reading change: `قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا` is not decorative politeness but a generous support practice precisely when parental strength has receded.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:24's sheltering wing and 17:28's easy word confirmed that noble speech is part of a support system; it keeps vulnerable persons socially received even when material help is delayed.

topics.reason: {{ar:عِندَكَ}} ({{tr:ʿindaka}}) modifies the reaching verb and carries the 2ms suffix, so the parents' aging occurs in the addressee's care-space.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative gerund naming old age as the reached state
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِبَرَ}} ({{tr:al-kibara}}) is the definite accusative state reached by the parents. The gerund names old age itself rather than labeling the parent, and the k-b-r magnitude field makes the local sense of advanced age feel weighty, though not a local activation of arrogance or unrelated greatness branches.
words.root_gloss_range: bigness, greatness, magnitude, old age, and arrogance; locally advanced age is selected with a weight-of-magnitude undertone

topics.headline: definite gerund makes old age a known destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices old age as a recognized state reached in the condition, not merely an adjective attached to a person.
topics.reason: {{ar:ٱلْكِبَرَ}} ({{tr:al-kibara}}) is the accusative object of reaching and a definite gerund naming the state.

topics.headline: magnitude field gives age moral weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local sense is advanced age, while the root's magnitude field makes that frailty feel weighty rather than trivial.
topics.reason: The local object of reaching selects old age; broader greatness and arrogance branches remain only as magnitude-pressure and same-surah contrast.

words.gloss_range: one-of-the-two expression with dual suffix inside the subject alternatives
words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدُهُمَآ}} ({{tr:aḥaduhumā}}) delays and narrows the subject to one member of the parental pair. The dual suffix keeps that one-parent scenario anchored in the two parents, and the phrase opens the scale that will include both together.
words.root_gloss_range: oneness and singularity; locally one parent is isolated without leaving the parental pair

topics.headline: one parent is isolated without weakening the pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a one-parent case is fully covered while still tied to the two-parent referent.
topics.reason: {{ar:أَحَدُهُمَآ}} ({{tr:aḥaduhumā}}) delays the subject and binds singular one-ness to the dual suffix.

topics.headline: one-parent case opens the scale to both parents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the care scenario scale from one parent to both without changing the obligation.
topics.reason: The sequence from {{ar:أَحَدُهُمَآ}} ({{tr:aḥaduhumā}}) to {{ar:كِلَاهُمَا}} ({{tr:kilāhumā}}) covers lighter and heavier care configurations.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive coordinator linking one-parent and both-parent alternatives
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) keeps one-parent and both-parent cases distinct while placing both under the same conditional answer. The command therefore cannot be limited to the presence of both parents.

topics.headline: or keeps one and both cases distinct under one answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command applies whether the aging case involves one parent or the full pair.
topics.reason: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) links the alternative nominative subjects inside one conditional rather than creating separate commands.

words.gloss_range: dual-totality noun with suffix naming both parents together
words.prose: {{ar:كِلَاهُمَا}} ({{tr:kilāhumā}}) names the maximum case as both parents together. It is a marked dual-totality form, not a mere number, so the upper end of the care burden is formally weighted.
words.root_gloss_range: pair-totality and bothness; locally the complete parental pair is the maximum condition

topics.headline: dual totality marks the maximum care condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names both parents together as a total pair, not just the number two.
topics.reason: {{ar:كِلَاهُمَا}} ({{tr:kilāhumā}}) is a suffix-bound dual-totality term parallel to the one-parent alternative.

words.gloss_range: apodosis connector beginning the mandated response to the condition
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from condition to response. Once aging in the addressee's presence is named, the apodosis begins immediately: no contempt sound, no harsh rebuke, and then positive noble speech.

topics.headline: fa turns condition into immediate directives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact hinge where parental aging turns into required speech discipline.
topics.reason: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks the conditional answer and attaches directly to the first prohibition in the surface sequence.

topics.headline: the answer is two bans and one positive command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that care is not a single vague attitude but a graduated sequence: no contempt, no harsh repulsion, and noble speech.
topics.reason: The clause architecture after the apodosis contains two prohibitions followed by an affirmative command.

words.gloss_range: first prohibitive particle governing the jussive speech verb
words.prose: The first {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is prohibitive, not a neutral negator. It governs {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) as a jussive command-ban and opens the negative-negative-positive sequence by barring the smallest speech harm.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive speech verb governed by prohibitive lā

topics.headline: prohibitive lā opens the smallest speech ban
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response begins by forbidding the smallest harmful utterance with full command force.
topics.reason: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is prohibitive, governs jussive {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}), and starts the negative-negative-positive directive series.

words.gloss_range: 2ms jussive speech verb under prohibition
words.prose: {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) makes the contempt sound an act of saying. It governs the parents as recipients and {{ar:أُفٍّۢ}} ({{tr:uffin}}) as the uttered content, so even a minimal sound falls under speech ethics; its shortened jussive form also suits a command that cuts off harmful speech. The same q-w-l root then returns in {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) and {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}), turning the ayah from blocked harmful speech to required honorable speech.
words.root_gloss_range: saying, utterance, and speech-act performance; locally even the smallest contempt sound is treated as said

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: minimal contempt utterance governed as speech content
maṣdar object naming the required speech act

topics.headline: even minimal contempt is governed as speech

topics.reason: {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) is jussive under prohibitive {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) and governs the dative recipient plus the uttered content.

topics.headline: local q-w-l refrain turns speech from harm to honor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not anti-speech; it blocks one speech act and later commands another from the same root.
topics.reason: The rows join {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}), {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}), and {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) into one speech-transformation axis.

words.gloss_range: dative lām marking parents as recipients of prohibited speech
words.prose: {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}) routes the prohibited utterance to the parents. The harm is direct address, not speech about them, and the repeated dative frame later carries the positive command to the same recipients; (17:40) supplies a same-surah contrast for grave human speech about God.

topics.headline: dative lām makes the harm direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the forbidden utterance is spoken to the parents, not merely about them.
topics.reason: {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}) in the dative phrase routes the prohibited speech toward the dual parental recipient.

topics.headline: same dative frame carries prohibition and command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same parents framed as recipients of both what is forbidden and what is required.
topics.reason: The dative phrase recurs before the prohibited contempt sound and before the commanded noble speech.

topics.headline: same surah contrasts parental speech with grave speech about God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a same-surah speech contrast: parental address here and grave speech about God in (17:40).
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete same-surah comparison to (17:40), where human speech about God is judged grave.

words.gloss_range: dual pronoun object of the dative lām in the prohibited-speech phrase
words.prose: {{ar:هُمَآ}} ({{tr:humā}}) keeps both parents compactly present inside the first dative phrase. The pronoun avoids repeating {{ar:ٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-wālidayn}}) while preserving the dual recipient at the point where contempt is forbidden.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite dual parental referent picked up by the pronoun

topics.headline: dual pronoun keeps both parents inside the ban
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both parents remain present at the moment the contempt utterance is prohibited.
topics.reason: {{ar:هُمَآ}} ({{tr:humā}}) is the dual object of the dative lām and points back to {{ar:ٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-wālidayn}}).

words.gloss_range: rare declined interjection functioning as the prohibited utterance
words.prose: {{ar:أُفٍّۢ}} ({{tr:uffin}}) is a tiny contempt interjection made grammatically countable as the thing not to be said. Its lexical tie to a trivial irritant and its pressed sound set the floor of disrespect extremely low; variant case endings shift classification around a stable contempt core. The same rare word is legitimate against idols in (21:67), prohibited toward parents here, and appears in parental contempt in (46:17).
words.root_gloss_range: a small contempt or disgust sound, with lexical links to trivial irritant dirt; locally it sets the minimum threshold of disrespect

topics.headline: tiny contempt sound becomes a prohibited object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the floor of disrespect is set extremely low: even a tiny irritated sound counts.
topics.reason: {{ar:أُفٍّۢ}} ({{tr:uffin}}) is governed by {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) and has lexical pressure from a trivial irritant, making minimal contempt legally visible.

topics.headline: case variants vary around a stable contempt sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant case treatment affects classification, while the contempt sound itself remains stable.
topics.reason: The qirāʾāt rows vary endings and tanwīn but do not replace the local interjection core.

topics.headline: rare word reverses legitimate and forbidden contempt contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same rare contempt word can be legitimate against idols in (21:67) but forbidden toward parents here and appears again in parental contempt at (46:17).
topics.reason: The rows provide the concrete occurrences (21:67), (17:23), and (46:17), allowing target-boundary contrast.

topics.headline: geminated sound makes impatience audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the minimal utterance as a pressed burst of disgust.
topics.reason: The phonetic row ties the doubled consonant to the short contempt sound.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector joining the second prohibition to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links the second prohibition to the first. The ayah does not choose between dismissive sound and harsher rebuke; it coordinates them as cumulative bans in an escalating pair.

topics.headline: wāw makes rebuke a cumulative second ban
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that harsh rebuke is added to the contempt-sound ban, not offered as an alternative to it.
topics.reason: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates {{ar:لَا تَقُل}} ({{tr:lā taqul}}) and {{ar:لَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا}} ({{tr:lā tanharhumā}}) into a parallel escalating pair.

words.gloss_range: second prohibitive particle renewing command force before the rebuke verb
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) renews prohibition before {{ar:تَنْهَرْهُمَا}} ({{tr:tanharhumā}}). Repeating the particle gives the harsher action its own command force and makes the double negative boundary audible.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive rebuke verb with dual object suffix

topics.headline: second lā gives rebuke its own full ban
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a repeated negative boundary as the ayah escalates from a contempt sound to active harsh repulsion.
topics.reason: The second {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is repeated before {{ar:تَنْهَرْهُمَا}} ({{tr:tanharhumā}}), renewing prohibitive force instead of merely borrowing it.

words.gloss_range: 2ms jussive transitive verb with dual object suffix prohibiting harsh rebuke
words.prose: {{ar:تَنْهَرْهُمَا}} ({{tr:tanharhumā}}) is a jussive transitive verb with the parents built in as direct dual objects. Local grammar selects harsh rebuke or repulsion, while the broader n-h-r river/day range is only a narrowed force-image: the rebuke must not overwhelm vulnerable parents, and the rare verbal deployment makes that interpersonal force stand out among mostly noun uses. The same ban protects a vulnerable petitioner in (93:10), and the harsher sound texture contrasts with the later noble-speech ending.
words.root_gloss_range: rebuke or repulsion alongside river/day branches; local transitive verbal grammar selects harsh rebuke while retaining force imagery

topics.headline: dual suffix makes parents direct affected objects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibited harshness lands directly on both parents, built into the verb by the dual suffix.
topics.reason: {{ar:تَنْهَرْهُمَا}} ({{tr:tanharhumā}}) is jussive under prohibition and carries the dual object suffix directly, without a preposition.

topics.headline: local grammar selects rebuke while preserving force imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local sense is harsh rebuke, while the river/day root range adds an overpowering-force undertone rather than a literal water image.
topics.reason: The transitive jussive verbal context blocks river or day as local senses, but the root evidence keeps force imagery available as a qualified pressure.

topics.headline: same prohibition protects vulnerable recipients in 93:10
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rebuke ban belongs to a broader pattern of not overpowering vulnerable recipients, explicitly paralleled in (93:10).
topics.reason: The rows cite the same prohibitive structure in (93:10), with a petitioner there and aging parents here.

topics.headline: sound texture suits forceful repulsion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a harsher onset before the ayah later smooths into noble speech.
topics.reason: The phonetic row links the n-h-r cluster to harsh repulsion and contrasts it with the closing speech phrase.

words.gloss_range: connector pivoting from the paired prohibitions to the positive command
words.prose: The final {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from what must not be done to what must be said. It coordinates the positive imperative with the two bans and carries a corrective force: not contempt, not rebuke, but noble speech.

topics.headline: final wāw pivots from bans to commanded speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not stop at restraint; the connector turns avoidance of harm into a positive speech duty.
topics.reason: The final {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) to the prior prohibitions and carries a corrective turn from “do not” to “say.”

words.gloss_range: 2ms imperative speech verb requiring an affirmative address
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) is the affirmative imperative that resolves the speech sequence. After the jussive prohibitions, it requires enacted verbal address to the parents, completed by the same recipient frame and by {{ar:قَوْلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan karīman}}) as the quality-governed speech act. The local echo from {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) to {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) shows that the goal is transformed speech, not silence, while the particle-driven warning logic from (17:22) becomes condition-response obligation here.
words.root_gloss_range: saying and utterance; locally the same speech root turns from blocked contempt to commanded noble speech

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier prohibited speech verb echoed by the imperative

topics.headline: imperative requires enacted noble address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the required response is not silence but an affirmative act of speech to the parents.
topics.reason: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) is a direct imperative completed by a dative recipient and {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) as its speech object.

topics.headline: negative saying becomes commanded saying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the climax of the sequence: blocked contempt is resolved by speech transformed into honor.
topics.reason: The local echo from {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) to {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) reverses polarity inside the same speech root.

topics.headline: particle architecture maps condition to response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices continuity with the prior ayah's pivot logic: particles move from warning to response obligation.
topics.reason: The boundary row compares the particle pivot from (17:22) with the condition-response architecture in (17:23).

words.gloss_range: second dative lām routing noble speech to the same parents
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}) sends the commanded speech to the same parents protected by the prohibitions. The repeated dative form binds restraint and honor to one recipient pair.

topics.headline: second dative routes noble speech to the protected pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same dual recipient protected from contempt now receives commanded honor.
topics.reason: The second {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}) repeats the dative route to the parents before {{ar:قَوْلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan karīman}}).

words.gloss_range: final dual pronoun preserving both parents as noble-speech recipients
words.prose: {{ar:هُمَا}} ({{tr:humā}}) again preserves the dual parental recipient. Even in the positive command, the grammar does not let one parent fade from view.

topics.headline: final pronoun sustains both parents through the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that neither parent recedes when the ayah turns to positive noble speech.
topics.reason: {{ar:هُمَا}} ({{tr:humā}}) again points to the two parents as the genitive object of the dative lām.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative maṣdar as cognate object of the command to say
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) makes the speech act itself the object of command. As a cognate maṣdar after {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}), it foregrounds the produced utterance; as an indefinite noun, it does not prescribe one script but leaves content open under the constraint of {{ar:كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:karīman}}). Surah 17 then shows a wider qualified-speech taxonomy in (17:28) and (17:40).
words.root_gloss_range: meaningful utterance and speech; locally the speech act itself becomes the regulated object

topics.headline: cognate maṣdar foregrounds the utterance itself
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command regulates the produced utterance itself, not just the speaker's inner attitude.
topics.reason: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) plus {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) repeats the speech root as verb and maṣdar, while agreement binds the following adjective to the noun.

topics.headline: indefinite speech allows many utterances under noble quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not script one formula; it opens the content while constraining its quality.
topics.reason: {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) is indefinite, so the utterance remains open as long as {{ar:كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:karīman}}) truly qualifies it.

topics.headline: Surah 17 catalogs qualified speech forms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that noble parental speech in (17:23) belongs to a same-surah taxonomy of speech qualities, including gentle speech in (17:28) and grave speech in (17:40).
topics.reason: The rows cite (17:23), (17:28), and (17:40), with shared qawl framing and context-specific adjectives.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative adjective qualifying the commanded speech
words.prose: {{ar:كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:karīman}}) locks noble quality onto the commanded speech through agreement with {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}). Its generosity, honor, and dignity range means the utterance must actively confer respect, not merely avoid insult. The exact noble-speech formula is distinctive for parental address, while k-r-m echoes human honoring in (17:70) and Satan's reference to the honored one in (17:62); the closing tanwīn cadence also answers the earlier {{ar:أُفٍّۢ}} ({{tr:uffin}}) with a nobler sound pattern.
words.root_gloss_range: nobility, generosity, honor, preciousness, and dignity; locally these qualities must characterize the utterance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier forbidden contempt sound answered by noble speech

topics.headline: agreement makes nobility inseparable from the utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that nobility is grammatically required of the speech itself, not left as a vague attitude around it.
topics.reason: {{ar:كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:karīman}}) matches {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) in accusative indefiniteness and functions as its qualitative adjective.

topics.headline: karīm makes speech give dignity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demanded words must confer honor and dignity, not merely avoid insult.
topics.reason: The k-r-m lexical evidence includes nobility, generosity, honor, preciousness, and forgiving when able to punish; locally those qualities modify speech.

topics.headline: parental address receives a marked formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing phrase as a distinctive parental-address formula, connected to the ayah's earlier excellence and to honoring language in (17:70) and (17:62).
topics.reason: The rows mark the exact phrase as unique here, compare related formulas such as (17:28) and (4:63), and link k-r-m to (17:70) and (17:62).

topics.headline: tanwīn cadence links forbidden and required speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing noble-speech phrase answer the earlier contempt sound while the boundary turns forsakenness into the duty to grant honor.
topics.reason: The sound row links {{ar:أُفٍّۢ}} ({{tr:uffin}}), {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}), and {{ar:كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:karīman}}) by cadence, and the boundary row contrasts withheld support with generous speech.
